title: Ricci entropy, RCD structures and Kahler spaces
summary: This paper is the final installment in our series on the geometric theory of complex Monge-Ampere equations. We study singular Kahler metrics on compact normal Kahler spaces with klt singularities whose volume densities lie in $L^p$ for some $p>1$. We show that a lower bound for the Ricci current in the sense of pluripotential theory is equivalent to a synthetic Ricci lower bound in the sense of RCD theory.
